disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV-TR MDD; drug-naïve or drug-free patients in discovery cohort (Dataset 1, N=114). A replication cohort (Dataset 2) also included 142 MDD patients (medicated), totalling 256 MDD patients across both cohorts. NM (quantile regression on HC) was applied to both datasets.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We recruited 114 MDD patients, 60 BD patients and 404 healthy controls (HC). All the patients were diagnosed by two experienced psychiatrists using the Structured Clinical Interview for the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 4th Edition, Text Revision (DSM-IV-TR)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Patients were recruited from two settings (Shenyang Mental Health Center inpatient dept. and First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University outpatient clinic), but MRI scanning was performed on a single scanner (Signa HDx 3.0T) at the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University only. Classified as SINGLE-SITE based on single MRI acquisition site.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All the patients were recruited from the inpatient department of the Shenyang Mental Health Center and the outpatient clinic of the Department of Psychiatry of the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China. [...] Structural MRI scanning was conducted on a Signa HDx 3.0 T superconductive MRI system (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfont, UK) at the First Affiliated Hospital, China Medical University."
dataset-of-origin.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Participants; Methods and materials / Image acquisition and MRI processing

age.detail: Age for discovery cohort MDD patients (Dataset 1, N=114); mean±SD reported in Table S1. Min/max not reported. Age for replication cohort MDD patients (Dataset 2, N=142) not reported by diagnosis (only by imaging subtypes in Table S12).

sex.detail: Sex for discovery cohort MDD patients (Dataset 1, N=114): male=34, female=80. Percentages calculated from counts (34/114=29.8%, 80/114=70.2%). Sex for replication cohort MDD patients (Dataset 2, N=142) not reported by diagnosis.
